children: : Prices for several fertilizers and building materials witnessed varied movements during trading on Monday, September 7, according to data from the Information and Decision Support Center (IDSC).
The price of ammonium sulfate recorded EGP 20,105 per ton, reflecting a daily increase of 3.2%.
Similarly, the ammonium nitrate increased by 3.9% daily, reaching EGP 24,878 per ton.
Urea was prices at EGP 25,146 per ton, a daily growth of 2.9%.
In the building materials sector, a ton of grey cement rose by 3% daily, reaching nearly EGP 4,035.
The price of a ton of investment-grade iron edged down by 0.3% to EGP 38,545.
Ezz Steel also decreased by 0.3% daily, hitting EGP 40,191 per ton.

title: ZAWYA: Egypt: Fertilizers, building materials prices mixed on September 7
